proposed.text: Under the checked PD 1096 source, which dormitory condition fits Division A-2?

options.text: An on-campus school dormitory for exclusive non-leasing occupants not exceeding ten persons.
A private off-campus dormitory with more than ten occupants.
A hotel used by transient guests for hire.
A warehouse with incidental sleeping quarters.

proposed.rationale: PD 1096 lists school dormitories on campus within Division A-2 when the residential building is for exclusive non-leasing occupants not exceeding ten persons.
proposed.explanation: PD 1096 lists school dormitories on campus within Division A-2 when the residential building is for exclusive non-leasing occupants not exceeding ten persons.
